notes: Two nominal clauses, each a construct chain; the one written copula joins the first clause's nominal predicate under rule 20, and the explicit אֲנִי takes only its own *I*. The second clause writes no copula, so nothing is placed there.

The article on הַשָּׁרוֹן is unrepresented because the ASV writes *a rose of Sharon* with no *the* for the phrase at all (rule 29's last sentence); the supplied *a* is the construct noun's own under rule 15. The second chain is rendered arthrously — *A lily of the valleys* — so nothing is fronted and הָ takes the *the* standing before its own word.
